verses.3: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,
verses.4: And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying,
verses.5: For I, saith the LORD, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.
verses.6: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the LORD: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the LORD.
verses.7: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of
verses.8: For thus saith the LORD of hosts; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.
verses.9: For, behold, I will shake mine hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me.
verses.10: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith the LORD.
verses.11: And many nations shall be joined to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of thee, and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto thee.
verses.13: Be silent, O all flesh, before the LORD: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.
